verdict.rationale: Google ADK is a framework for building agents, so a built-in assistant is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence shows ADK shipping its own assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The dev UI is for testing the user's own agents. The Task API is agent-to-agent delegation inside apps a developer builds. Agents CLI and the developer Skills connect the user's own external coding assistant. These are developer building blocks or user-side tooling, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
